```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
```



```{r}
#load dataset
schools <- read.csv("data_teacher_salaries.csv")
#clean data, removing all NA
schools <- schools %>%
  filter(!is.na(AVG_TEACHER_SALARY))
#find min-max teacher salray
min(schools$AVG_TEACHER_SALARY)
max(schools$AVG_TEACHER_SALARY)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# RANDOM FOREST MODEL – STRATIFIED BY REGION + ENERGY/CO2 TRACKING
# ============================================================

library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
set.seed(123)

#---------------------------------------
# DATA PREP
#---------------------------------------
schools$REGION <- as.factor(schools$REGION)
schools$OVERALL_SCORE <- as.numeric(schools$OVERALL_SCORE)

# Select relevant variables and remove NAs
schools_model <- schools %>%
  dplyr::select(
    OVERALL_SCORE,
    REGION,
    X._ECONOMICALLY_DISADVANTAGED,
    X._EB.EL_STUDENTS,
    MEDIAN_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_AREA
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

#---------------------------------------
# STRATIFIED TRAIN/TEST SPLIT BY REGION
#---------------------------------------
train_index <- createDataPartition(schools_model$REGION, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- schools_model[train_index, ]
test  <- schools_model[-train_index, ]

#---------------------------------------
# 5-FOLD STRATIFIED CROSS-VALIDATION (BY REGION)
#---------------------------------------
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  verboseIter = TRUE,
  index = createFolds(train$REGION, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
)

#---------------------------------------
# HYPERPARAMETER GRID
#---------------------------------------
tune_grid <- expand.grid(mtry = c(2, 3, 4))

# ============================================================
# R-NATIVE ENERGY / CO2 TRACKER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
track_start <- function() {
  Sys.time()
}

track_stop <- function(start_time, power_watts = 45, carbon_intensity = 0.4) {
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  runtime_hrs <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")) / 3600

  energy_Wh <- power_watts * runtime_hrs
  energy_kWh <- energy_Wh / 1000
  co2_kg <- energy_kWh * carbon_intensity
  co2_g <- co2_kg * 1000

  cat("⏱ Runtime:", round(runtime_hrs * 60, 2), "minutes\n")
  cat("⚡ Energy consumed:", round(energy_Wh, 2), "Wh\n")
  cat("🌍 Estimated CO2 emitted:", round(co2_g, 2), "gCO2eq\n")

  list(runtime_hrs = runtime_hrs, energy_Wh = energy_Wh, co2_g = co2_g)
}

# ============================================================
# TRAINING PHASE (with CO2 tracking)
# ============================================================
train_start <- track_start()

rf_model <- train(
  OVERALL_SCORE ~ REGION +
    X._ECONOMICALLY_DISADVANTAGED +
    X._EB.EL_STUDENTS +
    MEDIAN_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_AREA,
  data = train,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = ctrl,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntree = 500
)

training_impact <- track_stop(train_start)

# ============================================================
# TESTING PHASE (with CO2 tracking)
# ============================================================
test_start <- track_start()

rf_preds <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test)
rf_rmse <- RMSE(rf_preds, test$OVERALL_SCORE)
rf_r2   <- R2(rf_preds, test$OVERALL_SCORE)

testing_impact <- track_stop(test_start)

# ============================================================
# RESULTS + VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================
cat("\n✅ Random Forest Results\n")
cat("RMSE:", rf_rmse, "\n")
cat("R²:", rf_r2, "\n")

varImpPlot(
  rf_model$finalModel,
  main = "Variable Importance (Random Forest)",
  col = "darkorange"
)

# Optional energy summary table
impact_summary <- data.frame(
  Phase = c("Training", "Testing"),
  Runtime_min = c(round(training_impact$runtime_hrs * 60, 2),
                  round(testing_impact$runtime_hrs * 60, 2)),
  Energy_Wh = c(round(training_impact$energy_Wh, 2),
                round(testing_impact$energy_Wh, 2)),
  CO2_g = c(round(training_impact$co2_g, 2),
            round(testing_impact$co2_g, 2))
)
print(impact_summary)

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
